sentences: Representation of data sets in compact and simple formats is an important problem of data science with numerous applications.
Vectors, matrices and, more generally, tensors are used to naturally model data points.
In this section we state and recall some auxiliary results and facts, as well as define our probabilistic models.
The following theorem is the main tool for our estimates.
Our new lower bounds rely on the integral representation of the Bombieri-Weyl norm.
The latter is needed in the proof of Theorem 3.6.
We give a more detailed proof than the one given in [6, Proposition 4.24].
